What is photosynthesis in simple terms?

• Photosynthesis is the process by which plants, algae, and some bacteria convert light energy from sunlight into chemical energy.

During photosynthesis, plants, algae, and some bacteria convert light energy from sunlight into chemical energy by converting carbon dioxide and water into glucose and oxygen. The glucose produced is used by the plant as food, while oxygen is released into the atmosphere as a byproduct.
